design.principle: Alignment visible within same 160-word sequence via self-attention
design.scientist_requirement: Compare aligned pairs in same sequence vs random mismatch of same text; separate repetition consolidation, rewrite diversity, and semantic coverage

arms.aligned: [orig_i][simp_i][orig_j][simp_j]... both views adjacent, visible to attention
arms.mismatched: [orig_i][simp_k]... same sentences, scrambled pairing, no alignment
arms.single_orig: Diverse originals only — max coverage, no pairing or repetition
arms.single_repeat: Same originals 2x — repetition consolidation, no diversity

contrasts.mismatched_vs_single_orig: Effect of simplified text (unaligned) vs not

single_orig.note: Slightly smaller than other arms (95.5%) because available diverse unique sentences exhaust at ~9.55M words. The critical ALIGNED vs MISMATCHED comparison is exactly matched.

validation.note: ALIGNED, MISMATCHED, and SINGLE_REPEAT are exactly matched at 62499 examples / 9,999,840 words. SINGLE_ORIG is a supplementary control at 95.5% budget.
